name: Device Connector
description: Adds a Connect submenu to open SSH, Telnet, VNC, RDP, HTTP, HTTPS, or FTP as links; the system decides how to open them (like FTP).
author: chibashr

changes: Removed Web option; use HTTP and HTTPS only
All connection types open as links (ssh://, telnet://, etc.); system decides handler
Removed executable path settings; only default ports configurable
Added WEB, RDP, HTTP, HTTPS, FTP connection types
Authentication in launched app; removed SSH username from settings
Filepath settings: '...' browse button for executable paths
Connect submenu on device table context menu (SSH, Telnet, VNC, Web)
User-configurable executable paths and default ports
Default app detection for Windows (OpenSSH, PuTTY, Edge, VNC Viewer)
